title: Writing to a team's remote root, and the plugin host's roots
goal: kbroot.py push commits nothing it did not make, pushes a submodule root's commits to the root's own remote and then commits the superproject's gitlink bump, and refuses a fetch root as read-only; install-hooks sets push.recurseSubmodules=check so a superproject push that names an unpushed root commit is refused; in a plugin host fetch roots resolve into CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/roots/<name>; kbroot.py fetch --hook, run at SessionStart, fetches stale fetch roots within a bounded time and prints only failures; the /kb-ingest skill writes a team's facts into its submodule root and pushes it with kbroot.py push
